name: 10119 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10119 (New York) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10119 (New York) has 22 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
